# Getting Support

Thank you for your interest in the **GMAHK Galilea Digital Archive**.

This project provides an organized digital index, drive link integration, and multimedia repository for church services, Sabbath recordings, and event documentation.

---

## Technical Issues & Bug Reports

If you encountered a broken link, UI glitch, or build issue:
1. Check existing [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/zvenians/gmahk-galilea-digital-archive/issues) to avoid duplicate reports.
2. If new, submit an issue using the [Bug Report Template](https://github.com/zvenians/gmahk-galilea-digital-archive/issues/new?template=bug_report.md).
3. Include device details, browser version, reproduction steps, and screenshots if relevant.

---

## Feature Requests & Archive Enhancements

Suggestions for media preservation workflows or presentation improvements are welcome:
1. Open an issue using the [Feature Request Template](https://github.com/zvenians/gmahk-galilea-digital-archive/issues/new?template=feature_request.md).
2. Clearly explain the archiving use case and benefits for congregational memory.

---

## Security Vulnerabilities

Please **do not** report security vulnerabilities or exposed drive folder permissions publicly:
* Review our [Security Policy](https://github.com/zvenians/gmahk-galilea-digital-archive/security/policy).
* Report sensitive concerns directly to **simatupangkevin9@gmail.com**.

---

## Congregational Inquiries & Archive Access

For official archive additions, historical media contributions, or church drive access requests:
* Visit the production archive: [drive-galilea.vercel.app](https://drive-galilea.vercel.app)
* Contact the multimedia ministry or church secretariat through official channels.
